notes.body: Looks like c-ares version 1.34.7 was just released today, July 6 2026.
Unfortunately we will probably need to have a check here for the version.
Yeah, there is ARES_VERSION_PATCH but it doesn't seem to have been updated -.-
Seems like a new point release is coming: https://github.com/c-ares/c-ares/issues/1246
c-ares 1.34.8 has been released, and has correct version definitions.
